what: The state of every task the co-written articles' briefs ask for, checked against the repository by the librarian on 18 October 2026. The tasks themselves are read from each article's 'The brief' section by the build (one task per numbered item, with the role the section names); this file says what the repository shows about each: done, in-progress, blocked, open. Evidence names the file or page that proves it. A task not listed here is open.

states.open: nothing in the repository or the vault shows it started
states.in-progress: started; the evidence says how far
states.blocked: waits on a decision or another task
states.done: the done-when holds; the evidence shows it
